final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT healtheval, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY healtheval), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total FROM status_counts), shares AS (SELECT healtheval, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM totals) as share FROM status_counts), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares), above_avg AS (SELECT cnt, share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc)) SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc)) as avg_excess FROM above_avg
